interpretation: HERA created ACG and National SMART effective July 1, 2006. Their appearance in AY2006-07 agrees with the legal start.
coding_rule: Identify earlier absent headers as pre-program context; preserve NA, not an imputed institution-level zero.

source_title: ACG and National SMART Grant Participation
interpretation: Changes effective July 2009 expanded eligibility and altered grade-level/academic-year rules; a stable column name does not mean stable eligibility.
coding_rule: Flag an eligibility-regime break; do not splice apparent population changes away.

interpretation: Programs were not reauthorized and ended with AY2010-11; both source headers end in that year.
coding_rule: Preserve the historical measures and document post-2010 structural absence separately from within-program missingness.
evidence_excerpt: Because they have not been reauthorized

interpretation: CCRAA authorized TEACH beginning AY2008-09. Conditional service grants may later convert to unsubsidized loans.
coding_rule: TEACH volume is grant disbursement at report vintage, not proof of eventual grant retention; do not infer conversions from this panel.

interpretation: Rules changed service/conversion processes and terminology; FSA explicitly says front-end grant processing did not change.
coding_rule: Record policy context without inventing a new volume definition or a dropped variable.

interpretation: IASG first disbursement date is July 1, 2010. Separate IASG headers start AY2010-11.
coding_rule: Keep IASG separately through AY2023-24; do not assume recipients overlap with ordinary Pell recipients.

interpretation: PACT-related survivor eligibility expansion applied to AY2023-24 IASG and additional Pell; processing required institution/VA documentation.
coding_rule: Retain 2023-24 as a distinct eligibility regime; no separate survivor subgroup is available in the volume file.

interpretation: FAFSA Simplification replaced separate IASG with maximum Pell under the Special Rule, including legacy eligibility provisions. IASG headers disappear in AY2024-25 while Pell now includes eligible survivors.
coding_rule: An absent IASG column is not aid lost. Keep historical IASG; flag Pell composition break. Pell+IASG dollars can be an explicitly labeled related-program series, not a definition-invariant series.

source_title: Impact of Sequestration on Title IV
interpretation: Sequestration reduced TEACH/IASG awards and increased Direct loan fees according to first-disbursement rules; campus allocations were affected in AY2013-14. Pell was exempt.
coding_rule: Flag fiscal-year/disbursement-date regimes; never rescale annual observations by a single assumed rate.

source_title: TEACH: further changes to sequestration reductions
interpretation: Initial 2013 reduction guidance was revised: TEACH became 6.0% and IASG remained 10.0% for the applicable first-disbursement cohort; schools were instructed to correct earlier amounts.
coding_rule: Historical release vintage matters; do not apply obsolete initial 12.6%/37.8% figures.

source_title: GEN-10-14: two Pell Grants in one award year
interpretation: Students could receive up to two Scheduled Awards under the rules for AY2009-10 and AY2010-11.
coding_rule: Average dollars per recipient may change mechanically; yearly dollars are not capped at one Scheduled Award per recipient.

interpretation: Public Law 112-10 repealed the second Scheduled Award provision beginning AY2011-12.
coding_rule: Mark a break after 2010-11, while retaining the Pell column unchanged.

interpretation: Beginning AY2012-13 lifetime Pell eligibility is limited to 12 semesters or 600% of a Scheduled Award, including prior awards.
coding_rule: Eligibility restriction can change counts without a reporting-schema change.

interpretation: Year-Round Pell restored additional eligibility up to 150% beginning AY2017-18, initially requiring at least half-time for the additional portion. IASG calculation follows year-round Pell in the handbook.
coding_rule: Distinguish this 150% regime from the earlier 200% regime; count and dollar comparability differ.

source_title: COD implementation of Pell restoration for closed schools
interpretation: COD implemented restoration of Pell eligibility used at eligible closed schools during March 24-26, 2017.
coding_rule: Closures can affect subsequent eligibility as well as institutional identity; no automatic historical row reassignment.

source_title: Children of Fallen Heroes Scholarship Act
interpretation: Beginning AY2018-19 certain Pell-eligible children of deceased public safety officers receive maximum Pell; later incorporated into the 2024 Special Rule.
coding_rule: CFH is within Pell, not a separately observed grant column.

interpretation: Pell eligibility restored for qualifying incarcerated students in approved prison education programs under FAFSA Simplification.
coding_rule: Flag an expanded eligible population; earlier experimental-site participation means this is not the first possible prison-related Pell everywhere.

interpretation: SAI replaced EFC; Pell uses maximum, minimum, or calculated eligibility, including poverty-based pathways. Family/asset and need-analysis rules changed.
coding_rule: Do not interpret unchanged Pell labels as invariant eligibility, or compare aid-to-EFC with aid-to-SAI as the same measure.

interpretation: Enrollment intensity replaces discrete part-time Pell enrollment categories; additional Year-Round Pell no longer requires half-time enrollment.
coding_rule: Flag an award-calculation break; counts and mean award sizes can change without an enrollment change.

interpretation: AY2017-18 FAFSA began prior-prior tax-year income and earlier application opening; 2016-17 and 2017-18 both used 2015 income.
coding_rule: Choose income and economic covariate lags explicitly; this is application/eligibility timing, not a volume-field disappearance.

interpretation: New entrants without a qualifying secondary credential lost the general ability-to-benefit alternatives; pre-July 2012 enrollment could preserve eligibility.
coding_rule: Mark a student-eligibility break; program headers can remain present.

interpretation: 2014 legislation restored ATB routes for eligible career pathway programs; December 2015 legislation revised that definition and removed alternative Pell schedules.
coding_rule: Treat the historical letter as evidence for its period, not current operational guidance; include a 2014-15 transition flag.

source_title: GEN-21-04: removal of Selective Service and drug-conviction restrictions
interpretation: Restrictions stopped affecting Title IV eligibility beginning AY2021-22, with application questions/comment codes phased out in later years.
coding_rule: Eligibility change and form/schema change have different dates; do not use question removal as the eligibility effective date.

source_title: Campus-Based common elements: Perkins capital contributions
interpretation: Congress authorized no new Perkins Federal Capital Contributions after AY2004-05. Revolving-fund lending continued; repayments financed loans.
coding_rule: Federal Award is not new loan volume. Its column persists through AY2015-16 and cannot be used as a policy-termination proxy.

interpretation: Perkins authorization ended September 30, 2017; eligible previously disbursed undergraduate loans could have later disbursements through June 30, 2018.
coding_rule: Retain AY2017-18 activity and distinguish new awards, subsequent disbursements, and outstanding portfolio.

interpretation: No Perkins disbursements permitted after June 30, 2018; erroneous later activity requires correction. FISAP servicing reporting continues during wind-down.
coding_rule: Retain observed AY2018-19 zero fields; later absent volume fields do not imply all outstanding balances were zero.

interpretation: FISAP total FSEOG/FWS student expenditures include federal funds, authorized transfers, and the nonfederal share. Federal allocation is a different concept from student disbursements.
coding_rule: Never add federal_award to disbursements or assume equality. Volume workbooks call disbursements school-reported actual disbursements; exact all-year FISAP field lineage is not supplied.

interpretation: CARES Act waived campus institutional matching in AY2019-20 and AY2020-21, with a for-profit FWS employer exception; retrospective reimbursement could alter federal/nonfederal composition.
coding_rule: Flag both years; do not extrapolate the waiver to 2021-22 or assume a fixed federal share.

interpretation: Emergency authority allowed up to 100% of unspent FWS to transfer to FSEOG and emergency FSEOG grants under relaxed ordinary eligibility rules, including graduate students.
coding_rule: Changes in composition and allocations can reflect emergency flexibility; do not interpret all FSEOG recipients as ordinary Pell-priority undergraduates.

source_title: Use of Negative SAI in FSEOG Selection
interpretation: Institutions may treat negative SAIs as equal to zero for FSEOG selection beginning AY2024-25.
coding_rule: Outside selected campus scope ending AY2023-24; retain as forward boundary metadata, not observed data.

source_title: HERA Direct Grad PLUS operational guidance
interpretation: Graduate/professional PLUS began July 1, 2006; FSA explicitly supports processing AY2005-06 Direct Grad PLUS. Loan award-year follows the loan-period start, not necessarily first-disbursement calendar year. The FFEL workbook also contains AY2005-06 Grad PLUS under its loan-period definition.
coding_rule: Preserve observed AY2005-06 Grad PLUS. Legacy PLUS beside GRAD PLUS means parent PLUS, not a total already containing graduate amounts.
evidence_excerpt: At a minimum, we will process 2005-2006, 2006-2007, and 2007-2008 Direct PLUS Loans

source_title: Annual loan limit increases for certain Direct borrowers
interpretation: HERA raised first/second undergraduate and graduate unsubsidized annual limits for relevant first disbursements from July 1, 2007.
coding_rule: Effect is by first-disbursement date, potentially crossing loan-period award-year cohorts; no single-year mechanical rescaling.

source_title: GEN-08-08: Ensuring Continued Access to Student Loans
interpretation: ECASLA increased annual undergraduate unsubsidized limits by $2,000 for loans first disbursed from July 1, 2008.
coding_rule: Preserve change as a borrowing-cap regime; do not normalize volume as if eligibility limits were constant.

interpretation: No new FFEL first disbursements on or after July 1, 2010; valid earlier first disbursements can be followed by later disbursements. New federal lending moved to Direct.
coding_rule: Keep channels; disappearance of FFEL reports is not repayment or consolidation. Do not erase late FFEL activity in prior award-year cohorts.

source_title: Direct Loan interest rates and subsidized eligibility
interpretation: Graduate/professional students are ineligible for Direct Subsidized Loans for loan periods beginning July 1, 2012 or later. The graduate subsidized header ends AY2011-12.
coding_rule: Generic subsidized after 2011-12 is undergraduate scope; prior generic values may include both levels.

interpretation: Certain first-time borrowers became subject to a subsidized borrowing-duration limit of 150% of program length from July 2013.
coding_rule: Context for eligibility/volume; do not confuse with the separate 150% Year-Round Pell rule.

interpretation: 150% limitation no longer applies to loans with earliest disbursement on or after July 1, 2021; historical cohorts differ.
coding_rule: Use disbursement date boundary as context, not blanket recoding of all AY2021 values.

source_title: Early implementation of PLUS adverse-credit rules
interpretation: New adverse-credit standards and counseling apply to credit checks from March 29, 2015, regardless of loan period.
coding_rule: Mixed policy exposure can occur within an award year; volume data cannot identify affected borrowers.

interpretation: Award-year Q4 cumulative worksheet covers the year; quarterly tabs are not annual totals. Delayed reporting and later activity revise historical amounts. School-level unique recipients across all aid types are unavailable.
coding_rule: Use selected cumulative Q4 once; preserve report run date/hash. Never sum cumulative quarters or label cross-program recipient sums unique.

interpretation: Award year begins July 1 and ends June 30. Loans in these volume reports are assigned by loan-period start; subsequent disbursements can be recorded later. IPEDS components use different reference periods.
coding_rule: Record award_year_start/end explicitly and select an IPEDS alignment convention by analytic purpose; never label loan volume a pure fiscal cash-flow total.

interpretation: Perkins federal-award header ends after AY2015-16; no explicit source note ties this exact schema boundary to the earlier federal-capital cessation.
coding_rule: Preserve observed values, raw symbols, schema availability and missingness status; do not infer zeros from this event.

interpretation: Perkins recipient/disbursement headers end after AY2018-19; 2019-20 workbook footer explicitly attributes removal to no new Perkins loans.
coding_rule: Preserve observed values, raw symbols, schema availability and missingness status; do not infer zeros from this event.

interpretation: Direct undergraduate/graduate split becomes available AY2010-11. This is new reporting detail, not the creation of graduate unsubsidized borrowing.
coding_rule: Preserve observed values, raw symbols, schema availability and missingness status; do not infer zeros from this event.

interpretation: Selected reports begin <10 recipient and Privacy Redacted/Privacy Redaction dollar cells in AY2021-22. Publication-policy rationale and zero-exclusion bound are not documented by a located source note.
coding_rule: Preserve observed values, raw symbols, schema availability and missingness status; do not infer zeros from this event.

interpretation: Selected Direct sources change many empty-looking positions to literal dashes beginning AY2017-18. Available definitions do not define a dash as numeric zero.
coding_rule: Preserve observed values, raw symbols, schema availability and missingness status; do not infer zeros from this event.

interpretation: Cached selected campus reports end AY2023-24; grants/Direct continue AY2024-25. This is source coverage, not termination of FWS or FSEOG.
coding_rule: Preserve observed values, raw symbols, schema availability and missingness status; do not infer zeros from this event.

interpretation: The 2012-13 automatic-zero EFC income threshold was reduced to $23,000; its initially planned inflation-adjusted value had been $32,000. Eligibility methodology changed without a new volume header.
coding_rule: Control for the actual annual EFC formula when studying need-based aid; do not treat an unchanged volume definition as fixed eligibility.

interpretation: Annual Pell maximums and eligibility/payment schedules vary. For example, maximum scheduled Pell rose from $6,895 in 2022-23 to $7,395 in 2023-24. These parameters alter dollar totals with no header change.
coding_rule: Preserve nominal amounts and identify annual policy regimes. This registry is not a complete numeric annual Pell schedule dataset; do not substitute the example for all years.
